items.title: Dozens Of Boeing 787s Face Checks Over Fuel Tanks That Could Ignite When Hit By Lightning

The airworthiness directive will take effect next month and covers specific 787-8, 787-9 and 787-10 aircraft identified by Boeing.According to the FAA, 60 US-registered 787s fall under the order, with US airlines collectively operating over 170 Dreamliners.
